items.title: Align preview API versions to ARM common types v5
items.summary: Changes the two 2026-11 preview version declarations from ARM common types v6 to v5. All 109 mapped operations retain identical normalized request and response contracts, so the change restores cross-version wrapper compatibility without a REST or downstream SDK break.

compliance.summary: All Semantic intents match applicable fetched guidance.

intentAssessments.expected: Define API versions in an enum and specify dependencies and common types as needed for each version.
intentAssessments.actual: Both modified 2026-11 preview enum members explicitly select Azure.ResourceManager.CommonTypes.Versions.v5 with @armCommonTypesVersion.
intentAssessments.rationale: The modified version declarations follow the documented per-version common-types dependency pattern; the selected common-types version is explicit on each affected enum member.
intentAssessments.gap: The modified version declarations follow the documented per-version common-types dependency pattern; the selected common-types version is explicit on each affected enum member.
